description: This line plot illustrates the "Harmful with Refusal Ratio" for four different vision-language models—LlaVA-1.5-7B and Qwen2-VL-7B—evaluated on two distinct benchmarks, FigStep and MMSafetyBench, across four different input resolutions: 128, 256, 512, and 1024. The x-axis represents the input resolution, ranging from 128 to 1024, with tick marks at regular intervals of 128. The y-axis represents the Harmful with Refusal Ratio, scaled linearly from 0.0 to 0.5. The plot contains four lines: a blue line with circular markers for LlaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep, an orange line with square markers for Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep, a green line with triangular markers for LlaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench, and a red line with diamond markers for Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench. The blue line starts at approximately 0.20 at 128 and increases to about 0.36 at 1024. The orange line begins at approximately 0.15 at 128, rises to about 0.25 at 256, and then plateaus near 0.42 from 512 to 1024. The green line starts at approximately 0.07 at 128, increases to about 0.22 at 256, and then stabilizes near 0.38 from 512 to 1024. The red line begins at approximately 0.24 at 128, rises to about 0.42 at 512, and continues to increase to approximately 0.51 at 1024.
